question: GQ-006
action: back up the books catalogue, and discover what it contains

finding.headline: The Library DOES have titles. I have been claiming it does not.
finding.evidence: books.sqlite.book carries gid, title, authors, language, issued, rights — keyed on the same gid as passages.sqlite.book_body. 77,534 of 77,540 book bodies join to a title and author.
sample: 1 | The Declaration of Independence... | Jefferson, Thomas, 1743-18
3 | John F. Kennedy's Inaugural Address | Kennedy, John F.
finding.consequence: scripts/ia-dedup-check.mjs states 'The Library has no titles on its book edges, so title matching is unavailable' and falls back to author-level matching. That is a weaker check justified by a false premise. A title-aware dedup is possible and would be strictly stronger.
finding.not_done: Title normalisation (subtitles, editions, leading articles) is its own problem and deserves measuring rather than guessing. Comment corrected; implementation not attempted.
